description: Supplies the Slate brush for an inline rich-text image tag.

Brush.simple: Brush drawn for the matching inline image.
Brush.technical: FindImageBrush resolves the tag or ID as an Unreal row name in CustomImageSet. It calls FindRow with warning disabled and returns the address of this brush on success or null when the row lookup fails. The native implementation does not branch on IconSizeType.

usages.detail: Exposes the decorator's CustomImageSet table as a widget property.
Resolves a rich-text tag or ID to the row's Slate brush.

notes: FindImageBrush directly dereferences CustomImageSet. The caller path needs an assigned table for this lookup.
The image-row schema and its consumer are present in the native source. The dataset has no matching asset export.
